errors.evidence: The description identifies the color of slice B (治疗) as 'deep purple' (深紫色). In the chart, this slice has a purplish-blue or indigo color, not deep purple.
The description identifies the color of sub-slice D2 (锻炼) as 'gray' (灰色), but it is dark blue in the chart.
The description identifies the color of sub-slice D3 (减肥) as 'black' (黑色), but it is light blue in the chart.
The description identifies the color of sub-slice D0 (其他) as 'dark gray' (深灰色), but it is a very light blue in the chart.

errors.text_span: 类别按其在饼图中的出现顺序排列。
errors.evidence: This sentence, which translates to 'Categories are arranged in the order they appear in the pie chart,' is ambiguous and incorrect. The description lists the categories alphabetically (A, B, C, D, E, F), which does not match their visual arrangement in the chart. The chart slices themselves are not sorted by size or any other discernible order.
